notes.title: 0.7.0.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- The “Hot Potato” achievement now unlocks correctly.
- Fixed a bug where the “Wrong Time” achievement wouldn’t unlock if combat music was disabled in the settings.
- Skinning can now be performed during combat.
- Fixed a bug where the AKM from the stash in the Underground Facility could become invisible.
- Fixed a bug where the Saiga magazine could disappear after being removed.
- Fixed several bugs with random generation of the new location: blocked spawn points, hollow buildings with only the first floor, and flickering walls in some apartments.
- Slightly increased the maximum possible size of the Dead City generated area.
- Several other minor improvements and fixes.

notes.title: 0.7.0.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug preventing completion of the Scientists’ questline.
- Fixed a bug where the player’s right-hand collision would push the body and block movement in the Underground Facility.
- Improved performance on the Dead City location.
- Several other minor fixes.

notes.title: 0.7.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug preventing progression from stage 2 to stage 3 in the Scientists’ questline.
- The “On Tiptoes” achievement now unlocks correctly.
- Fixed a duplication bug with the Energy Rifle.
- Desk lamps in apartments on the new map now allow you to unscrew light bulbs, just like everywhere else.
- If the regular light on the underbarrel flashlight was turned off, it will no longer turn back on after using the UV flash.
- Several other minor fixes.

notes.title: 0.6.0.5 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with automatic bolt/slide grabbing when using the “Trigger” grip mode.
- Fixed a bug where demon animations could break after the last hotfix.
- Fixed a rare bug that could prevent weapon cleaning.
- Fixed a bug where right-hand grip poses could be broken during the first visit to the Hideout (items appeared slightly misaligned in hand).
- Fixed a bug where the flashlight would keep shining from your pocket if you quickly toggled the UV flash and holstered it.
- Slightly reduced the delay before you can load a new crossbow bolt after firing.

notes.title: 0.6.0.4 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p]- The Mosin rifle bolt system has been reworked. It now operates more smoothly and with less system load.
- When cycling the bolt/slide on any weapon (pushing it forward), the hand now automatically releases. This prevents cases where the physics could behave unstably, causing rounds to be ejected accidentally.
- Fixed a bug where selling food and drink items to Mityai displayed the wrong price (without the additional bonus) when the interface language is set to English.
- Fixed a bug where selling a grenade without a pin caused the explosion area to remain active.
- Zakharich’s intro has been shortened for most players; the full version will now only play if you previously listened to the scientists’ dialogue.
- Added new burning and heavy injury voice lines for two more bandit voices.
- Updated the visual appearance of the wolf skin and boar meat items.
- The upgraded detector’s needle is now visible when using night vision.
- Some other minor changes and fixes.

Known issue: In Trigger grab mode, the hand automatically re-grabs the bolt/slide after releasing it — a fix is coming soon.[/p]

notes.title: 0.6.0.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where hides, meat, and demon flesh were being marked as damaged even when using knives, the crossbow, or UV grenades after the previous hotfix.
- Skinning can now only be performed after the body has fully hit the ground, rather than immediately upon death.
- Fixed a bug where the alpha demon kill quest could incorrectly complete after finishing the old stealth mission in the Garage Cooperative, which has since been removed and replaced.

notes.title: 0.6.0.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p]- You can now simply toss the tools into Mityai’s crate to deliver them. 
- A timer has been added to Truffle showing when his stock will refresh. 
- Fixed a bug where a magazine wouldn’t insert into a weapon after moving it from one hand to the other. 
- Fixed a bug where you could still obtain undamaged skins, meat, or flesh if the enemy was killed with a single shot. 
- Fixed a bug where the dog could bark endlessly at surrendered or heavily wounded enemies. 
- Fixed a bug where demons near campfires could ignore the player until attacked. 
- Fixed incorrect collision on many objects in the Garage Cooperative location — most car doors should no longer block bullets unrealistically. 
- Fixed an issue where the soldier’s side quest wouldn’t show up in the PDA if the hunter’s side quest wasn’t started first. 
- The tennis ball and teddy bear no longer spawn in the Forest location (temporary but reliable fix for the broken arms bug). 
- Some other minor fixes and improvements.[/p]

notes.title: 0.6.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the flamethrower didn’t fire.
- Fixed the needle indicator on the upgraded detector not working.
- Bandit groans when heavily wounded are now slightly quieter.
- The "Treasure Hunter" achievement now unlocks when you find an artifact in the Zone, rather than when you sell it to Zakharich.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1 | Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Hunters!

It’s been a full year since CONVRGENCE entered Early Access — and what a journey it’s been. Over this time, the game has received countless fixes, improvements, and, of course, plenty of new content. But there’s still so much more to come!

We’ll go over the highlights of the first year and what lies ahead in an upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2609610/view/508452792038326528]dev diary[/url], but today I’ve got a brand-new anniversary update for you!

[h2]What’s New:[/h2]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664458/e7a2fd59e54295ef8e48de2ffaa6fc0d27eb26d0.png[/img]

[h2]What's New:[/h2]

[h3]Bandit AI overhaul[/h3]

The bandit AI overhaul, which began late last year with the addition of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2609610/view/508441373248062179]ragdoll physics[/url] and numerous AI bug fixes, is now complete.

[list]
[*] Bandits now behave more dynamically and realistically in combat: they reposition, take cover, retreat under heavy fire, and flee from grenades.
[*] The last surviving bandit in a group can now surrender and drop their weapon.
[*] Instead of always dying instantly, bandits can sometimes fall wounded to the ground.
[*] Bandits now have a more diverse loot pool, including high-reputation weapon magazines and valuable consumables.
[*] Bandits wield a wider variety of weapons, including new additions to their arsenal.
[*] They are now divided into classes based on their weapon type, each with unique combat behavior. For example, snipers never close the distance, while shotgun-wielding bandits aggressively push forward.
[*] Bandits can now miss shots at long distances. The greater the range, the higher the chance of missing. Other factors, like target movement speed, also affect their accuracy.
[*] Tracer rounds are now visible from bandit gunfire to make firefights more readable.
[*] New voice lines added for bandits to match their improved combat behavior (changing positions, retreating, surrendering).
[*] Numerous bug fixes and other AI behavior improvements listed in other sections.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664458/b7ec60d6ba86bd4a0d690fe547cf4e785d6a6445.gif[/img]

Please note that this overhaul primarily focuses on making bandits behave more realistically rather than significantly increasing their difficulty. Bandits are just one of the planned human enemy factions in the game and are meant to be among the easiest opponents. 

However, for those looking for a greater challenge, [u][b]basic difficulty settings[/b][/u] have been added, adjusting enemy damage dealt and received. More advanced difficulty customization will be introduced in future updates.

[h3]New Weapons & Bleeding Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Two new weapons: the Mosin-Nagant and IZh-43 sawed-off shotgun, both lootable from bandits.
[*] New gun rack above the table for additional weapon storage.
[*] Bleeding mechanics added – wounds now have a chance to cause bleeding, with duration based on difficulty settings.
[*] Bandages introduced along with a new bandaging mechanic.
[*] Tutorial updated to include a bandaging step.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0nYQFHc.gif[/img]

[h3]New Black Market Trader – Truffle[/h3]

A new underground trader has set up shop at the base! You can read more about him in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2609610/view/542224071645987087]latest development diary[/url].

[list]
[*] Truffle sells rare items that were previously only available as loot in raids, such as drum magazines or underbarrel UV flashlights and other rare attachments. 
[*] He also stocks quest items needed for active missions, so if you're having trouble finding a specific item, Truffle has got you covered! 
[*] His inventory is limited and refreshes daily, so be sure to check in regularly for the best deals!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664458/24698b346ddec88a861d5f4f17162a631b16db6d.png[/img]

[h3]Dog Companion Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your dog can now take damage in combat, and enemies can attack it. 
[*] If critically injured, it will require medical assistance to recover.
[/list]

[h3]Additional Improvements & Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Over 100 new voice lines for Zakharich, including unique commentary on your purchases.
[*] New bandit dialogues revealing more about the game’s lore.

[*] New visual effects for damage and critical health.

[*] New competitive season started. Leaderboards have been reset (previously earned leaderboard rewards remain unaffected).
[*] 13 new Steam Achievements added.
[*] Additional optimization improvements.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2609610/view/542224071645987087]bandit boss[/url] was originally planned for this update but has been delayed. He is now expected to be introduced next month.

Hello hunters!


Update 0.4.3, first of all, focuses on bringing Steam Achievements to the game.

Some of these are simple and unlock naturally as you play, while others will push your skills to the limit. Trophy hunters, this is your time to shine!

In addition to achievements, this update improves the usability of several existing mechanics and, most importantly, fixes the broken AI behavior of bandits, making encounters with them more engaging than ever. But let’s dive into the details!


[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]

Achievements Added: The game now features its first set of 37 Steam achievements, with plans to expand the list significantly in future updates. You can find the full list of achievements here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2609610/achievements


Some achievements that can no longer be earned without starting a new game (e.g., reaching the second reputation level or obtaining the crossbow) will automatically unlock when you log in.

Join our Discord community -  https://discord.gg/convrgence to share your ideas for new achievements!

[list]
[*] A new system has been added to restore progress based on unlocked achievements in case your save file was lost. Keep in mind that the game currently does not support cloud saves, which will only be added at the full release due technical issues.
[*] If your dog gets stuck and can’t catch up, it will now teleport to your location automatically.
[*] Added a new animation for the vise on the workbench.
[*] When trying to install a conflicting attachment on a weapon, the visual indicator now turns red.
[*] A special plush bear toy has been added as loot - your four-legged friend will love it!
[*] A brief backstory has been added at the start of the game.
[*] Gas masks can now be stored in your backpack.
[*] New ambient sound effects have been added to several locations.
[*] The Forest map now features more details and new points of interest.
[/list]

The next major update will focus on significantly improving Bandits: ragdoll physics for bodies, expanded weaponry (including new guns), and more tactical behavior during combat. However, this update already fixes numerous bugs related to their AI, which, along with other changes, makes fights against them much more engaging. Details below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664458/a7716f147f23cc445a56c0651c7d53f7a83c9e8e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Bandits now react much faster, with reaction times depending on the distance to the player. At long range, you still have time to escape their line of sight. At close range, they will engage immediately.
[*] Bandit detection range has been significantly increased.
[*] Bandits are now more aggressive in combat.
[*] The hitbox for bandit heads and helmets has been adjusted to better match their actual size, making headshots more challenging.
[*] Renamed the "Stash" at the base to "Storage" to avoid confusion with Hunter stashes on locations.
[*] Switching tabs in the backpack and storage now requires pressing the trigger.
[*] Attachments now auto-mount when brought close to the appropriate slot.
[*] Crossbow bolts now auto-insert into quivers when brought close.
[*] Quest items for the Hunter are now handed over automatically when brought to his hand.
[*] Adjusted sounds for attaching and removing weapon modifications.
[*] The PDA step in the tutorial now only progresses after all tabs have been viewed.
[*] Starting a new game now places a free revolver suppressor on the workbench in the shooting range.
[*] Some yellow hint notes at the base have been updated for the current gameplay systems.
[*] The Trader’s introductory speech has been shortened.
[*] Shadows in the Forest map are now more contrasted.
[*] Grass density and size in the Forest map have been increased.

[*] Fixed an issue where bandit-thrown dynamite would explode instantly.
[*] Fixed a bug where bandits wouldn’t attack the player if there was a significant height difference.
[*] Fixed an issue where pumpkins from the Halloween event could still spawn and count toward regular quests.
[*] Fixed a bug where upgrading to level 3 storage would still show it as level 2.
[*] Fixed multiple issues allowing conflicting attachments to be installed simultaneously on weapons.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Trader’s fog message played repeatedly instead of only during the first Forest raid.
[*] Fixed a bug where the gas mask could behave strangely when switching suits while holding it in hand.
[*] Fixed an issue where water step sounds would overpower all other in-game sounds.
[/list]
Other minor tweaks and fixes.

[h3][b]Support CONVRGENCE[/b][/h3]

If you’re enjoying CONVRGENCE and appreciate the hard work I put into it, consider nominating it as the Best VR Game of the Year on Steam. While winning might not be realistic, every vote counts and helps spread the word about the game!

NikZ.
